fields: h, points [{t, d, part, x, y}] (part: "divert", "outlet" or "record", the station the point is about; a point without one takes the next free part; x, y optional: the text block's top left in % of the drawing, default per part), modes [dry label, wet label] (the switch's two words, default "Dry", "Water"). at and figure are the fallback renderer's and are ignored here.
best_for: WetRunHmi sets an explainer as the test bay's water route on a navy blueprint ground: one double-wall pipe runs across the section and folds down and back up, each point sits beside its station, and a two-position switch runs the skid dry or with water (look `wet-run-hmi`, prose block `as: "explainer"`).
